title: Wicket's Galaxy Explorer — Forest Moon Expedition
description: Ewok engineers reinvent the 1979 blue-and-grey Galaxy Explorer: amber eye canopies in a rounded hood, ear scanners, woven solar-glider wings, bark-clad ion engines, a removable cargo hatch and boarding ramp. Includes a six-wheel log scout and a living-tree station with yellow windows, a thatched roof and lunar radar.

sections.name: Landing skids and tied flight deck
Classic planet insignia and ship radar
